title: spec/appendix-ccp12-hopping.md: No guard for NChannels <= 1 causes selection of non-existent channels
description:
When NChannels = 0 or 1, the formula N = MAX(NChannels - 1, 2) yields N=2, then returns 1 + (Hash MOD 2) which selects channels 1 or 2. These channels do not exist when only CH0 is available. Same issue exists at line 159 for synchronized hopping.

Fix suggestion: Add early return for NChannels <= 1: IF NChannels <= 1 THEN RETURN 0
